thread:
maya (PM): quick post-launch note: a couple customers on Dedicated saw embedding latency/regressions after yesterday's batching tweak. need mitigation and a roadmap ticket. cc @aj @tom

aj (Eng Lead): seeing it in staging too. p95 spikes when batch_size > 10. options: revert, per-tenant cap, or longer tuning. I prefer per-tenant cap behind a flag. low risk.

tom (SRE): logs show timeouts: `ERROR embed-svc req=tnx batch=16 dur=92s`. I'll add alerts and help wire the flag into infra.

lee (Customer Success): customer asks for ETA and a note that SLAs will be restored. temporary cap ok for them.

rachel (Design): separate request: customers want better recall; that's a product/UX enhancement, put it on the backlog.

maya (PM): plan: AJ -> implement cap + PR, TOM -> infra rollout and monitoring, RACHEL -> customer comms, maya (pm). create epic "embeddings robustness" for tuning. Target canary today.

aj (Eng Lead): PR up: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/512 (adds per-tenant batch cap). requesting quick review.

tom (SRE): staging QA: batch=16 -> 94s, batch=8 -> 21s. cap at 8 looks safe. approving PR.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1817774480. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng Lead): kicking canary now.

tom (SRE): canary healthy at +10m. p95 normalized, no timeouts for sample tenants.

maya (PM): :white_check_mark: mitigation rolled. creating RDW-451 for the robustness epic (quantization, kv-cache sizing, evals). owners: aj (eng), tom (sre), rachel (comm), maya (pm).

lee (Customer Success): customer confirmed SLA improved. please ping me when RDW-451 grooming is scheduled so we can invite them to the demo.

aj (Eng Lead): will add experiment list to RDW-451 and estimate effort in grooming.

maya (PM): closing thread. short-term cap stays until we ship robustness work.
